limitations.statement: The printed known-L NG expression on p.544 is not adopted as an exact total query count; the executable recurrence has K+1 gradient calls for x_K.

performance_links.scope_note: Same-batch performance statement for this exact recurrence and output; no unrestricted Oracle Complexity claim. Subject to independent review and publisher dependency binding.

variants.cost: One full exact gradient at y_k per iteration; K+1 calls for x_K. Zero function-value calls. Scalar square roots/arithmetic and Hilbert-space vector operations are separate computational resources, not gradient calls; no finite-dimensional runtime claim is made. Known-L initialization requires no gradient evaluation at an auxiliary z.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF page 1 / p.543, equations (3)–(5); PDF page 2 / p.544, final known-L paragraph.
variants.name: Known-L specialization
variants.output: x_K after K+1 gradient calls, with original indexing beginning at k=0. No averaging, random output or projection.
variants.query_and_update: For k=0,…,K, query g_k=∇f(y_k); set x_k=y_k−g_k/L, a_{k+1}=(1+sqrt(4a_k²+1))/2, and y_{k+1}=x_k+((a_k−1)/a_{k+1})(x_k−x_{k−1}). The last extrapolation may be skipped when only x_K is requested.
variants.requirements: Hilbert space E; convex continuously differentiable f:E→R; globally L-Lipschitz gradient; nonempty minimizer set for the associated performance statement. Exact gradient evaluations and exact mathematical updates.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set x_{−1}=y_0 and a_0=1. Maintain x_{k−1}, y_k and a_k. In this specialization α_k=1/L for every k≥0; the adaptive α_{−1} secant estimate and its auxiliary point z are unnecessary.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use the supplied global bound L throughout; do not execute equation (4) as a numerical line search. Stop at the supplied budget K. The source does not give an observable error certificate using only these gradient calls; choosing a budget from a target error additionally requires usable distance information.
